profile.name: Videlma Sufi Romadhani
profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer
about: Diploma student in Informatics Management at Politeknik Negeri Jember, building web and mobile systems with Laravel, Flutter, and MySQL.
Currently finishing a thesis on a hybrid LSTM-XGBoost stock prediction system, alongside client projects spanning POS, asset management, and mobile apps.

research.narrative: I build production-ready web and mobile systems, from POS and asset-management platforms to a hybrid LSTM-XGBoost stock prediction system for my thesis, focused on solving real operational problems for the people who use them.

focus.name: Web Development
focus.description: Laravel and MySQL systems including POS, asset management, and admin dashboards built for real organizations.

focus.name: Mobile Development
focus.description: Flutter apps with clean UI and REST API integration, including MongoDB-backed authentication flows.

focus.name: Applied Data & AI
focus.description: Time-series forecasting with a hybrid LSTM-XGBoost model, and early exploration of AI coding agents.
